TweetNaCl, version 20140427, unmodified.

Source: https://tweetnacl.cr.yp.to/20140427/tweetnacl.c and tweetnacl.h
Authors: Daniel J. Bernstein, Bernard van Gastel, Wesley Janssen, Tanja Lange, Peter Schwabe,
Sjaak Smetsers.

TweetNaCl is "a self-contained public-domain C library" (https://tweetnacl.cr.yp.to/).
netbird-lite supplies the randombytes() hook in src/nbl_crypto.c.
